title: Canonical open-cover triangle expressed as adjunction mates
statement: Let X be a ringed space [def-weil-locally-ringed-space-morphism], R its underlying ring sheaf, U,V opens covering X, W=U∩V, and E∈D(R) [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let R_U,R_V,R_W be exact additive derived restriction functors and T_U,T_V the exact derived restrictions from U,V to W. Let c_U:R_U T_U≅R_W and c_V:R_V T_V≅R_W be the canonical composition comparison isomorphisms. For any chosen left adjoints L_U,L_V,L_W with adjunctions α_U,α_V,α_W, define κ_U by transposing c_U(E)⁻¹ T_U(η_U(R_U E)) c_U(L_U R_U E) under α_W, and define κ_V similarly. Then there exists δ:E→(L_W R_W E)[1] such that L_W R_W E → L_U R_U E ⊕ L_V R_V E → E → (L_W R_W E)[1] is distinguished, with arrows (κ_U,-κ_V), (ε_U(E),ε_V(E)),δ. The Lean statement assumes explicitly the exactness, additivity and derived-category instances for these restriction functors.

source.place: Tags 08BU, 08BT and 08BW: lower-shriek triangle and its canonical nested-open maps

proof.text: Specialize [lem-pur-site-restriction-module-adjunction-exact] to the precoverage underlying the topological site, identifying its generated topology with the original topology. This supplies exact concrete extension-by-zero functors and adjunctions. Choose a representative K of E using essential surjectivity of Q. Apply [lem-sc-open-cover-mate-complex-short-exact] to obtain the complex-level sequence and its canonical degreewise mate formulas.

Construct the presentation isomorphisms for the three chosen derived left adjoints by localizing each termwise adjunction and using leftAdjointUniq. The proved derivedPresentation_counit equation identifies their counits. Apply [lem-sc-localization-nested-adjunction-mate] to f≫fst and −(f≫snd). Additivity of Q and biproduct extensionality identify the transported first arrow with (κU,−κV). The mapBiprod comparison and the counit equations identify the second arrow with the pair of chosen counits.

Apply [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-triangle] to the obtained short exact sequence. Define δ by conjugating triangleOfSESδ with e and the shift of the inverse overlap presentation. Build Triangle.isoMk from the three presentation isomorphisms and the two verified arrow equations. The third square is cancellation of inverse shifted isomorphisms. Invariance of distinguishedness under triangle isomorphism proves the original statement.

proof_origin.note: Lean reduction to a termwise canonical short exact sequence and generic compatibility of localization with a single nested mate; the counit and triangle transports are proved.

lean.statement:
theorem open_cover_adjunction_triangle (X : AlgebraicGeometry.RingedSpace.{u})
    (R : Sheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) RingCat.{u})
    (hR : R = (sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj X.sheaf)
    (U V : Opens X) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤)
    [(overFunctor.{u} R U).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (overFunctor.{u} R U)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (overFunctor.{u} R U)]
    [(overFunctor.{u} R V).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (overFunctor.{u} R V)]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (overFunctor.{u} R V)]
    [(overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V))]
    [(overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U))]
    [(overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)).Additive]
    [PreservesFiniteLimits (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V))]
    [PreservesFiniteColimits (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} R)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V)))]
    (E : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} R))
    (LU : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over U)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} R))
    (LV : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over V)) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} R))
    (LW : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (R.over (U ⊓ V))) ⥤
      DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} R))
    (adjU : LU ⊣ (overFunctor.{u} R U).mapDerivedCategory)
    (adjV : LV ⊣ (overFunctor.{u} R V).mapDerivedCategory)
    (adjW : LW ⊣ (overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory) :
    let RU := (overFunctor.{u} R U).mapDerivedCategory
    let RV := (overFunctor.{u} R V).mapDerivedCategory
    let RW := (overFunctor.{u} R (U ⊓ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let TU := (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)).mapDerivedCategory
    let TV := (overMap.{u} R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)).mapDerivedCategory
    let cU := openRestrictionComparison R (homOfLE inf_le_left : U ⊓ V ⟶ U)
    let cV := openRestrictionComparison R (homOfLE inf_le_right : U ⊓ V ⟶ V)
    let κU := (adjW.homEquiv (RW.obj E) (LU.obj (RU.obj E))).symm
      (cU.inv.app E ≫ TU.map (adjU.unit.app (RU.obj E)) ≫ cU.hom.app (LU.obj (RU.obj E)))
    let κV := (adjW.homEquiv (RW.obj E) (LV.obj (RV.obj E))).symm
      (cV.inv.app E ≫ TV.map (adjV.unit.app (RV.obj E)) ≫ cV.hom.app (LV.obj (RV.obj E)))
    ∃ δ : E ⟶ (LW.obj (RW.obj E))⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧,
      Triangle.mk (biprod.lift κU (-κV))
        (biprod.desc (adjU.counit.app E) (adjV.counit.app E)) δ ∈ distTriang _
